label: Fleet response
description: Ends a fleet's comm-link dialog the vanilla way (as the Knights of Ludd's stop): the fleet lets the player go, attacks, or the player flees. The comm link is cut and the fleet screen (Engage, Leave) shows. Use it in an encounter's comm-link dialog (Encounters > Hail).
changes: The flee choice reads "player flees" ("they" was ambiguous).

fields.label: Response
fields.help: Let them go: the fleet stops being hostile and flies off; its encounter's outcome is "avoided" (paid, talked out of it). Fight: the fleet turns hostile and the player can't leave; the fight's result is the encounter's outcome (a player much stronger than the fleet can still leave, as in vanilla). Player flees: the block on leaving is lifted and the fleet keeps chasing; a hail when it catches them can test "The player fled from this fleet".
